verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly publish a developer API with interactive docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing Akamai and Incapsula bot walls on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov. Nothing documents an API reference or runnable examples, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
